Election results could have far reaching impacts for the sector

When asked "What is the most likely impact from the election results on the alternative asset managers?" investors were fairly mixed in their responses, indicating to us that investors expect a number of changes. The most common response was increased tax on carried interest (33%), followed by higher rates impacting financing costs and some
returns (27%), then stronger economic growth and healthy returns (20%). Few investors expect a decrease in bank regulation slowing alternative manager growth in new areas (13%) along with too much euphoria leading to a market correction (7%).
